Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps: FinLytics embed/rerank 5xxs

Heads-up on what I found from an initial pass on the repro payload: this looks like a combo of oversized inputs + large reranker batch that pushes the inference path into memory/latency spikes. Notes / suggested workarounds:

- Root cause hypothesis: Long documents (several >8k tokens) fed into the embeddings call followed by a reranker that requests top-100 candidates leads to high KV cache pressure and occasional OOM or request queue exhaustion in the reranker process, which surfaces as 502/504 upstream (not a network-only issue).
- Immediate short-term mitigations to test (safe to do from your side):
  * Reduce reranker candidate count to 20–30 (top-20 was already mentioned)
  * Use smaller embedding batch sizes (e.g., 4 instead of 8)
  * Increase client timeout to 60s–90s while we validate — we saw spikes to 12–18s in traces
  * If possible, preprocess to chunk documents >4k tokens and dedupe similar chunks before embedding

- Longer-term fixes we will pursue:
  * Improve server-side backpressure handling and add circuit breaker for reranker to fail-fast when memory thresholds are hit
  * Add SDK guidance for best-practice defaults (batch sizes, timeouts, chunking) and an automated prompt to use streaming/structured output when input size exceeds thresholds

- Workaround I pushed to a sandbox: I reproduced the 5xx with the payload; reducing batch size to 4 removed the 5xxs in our sandbox run. Upgrading to redwood-js v0.24.0-rc2 also showed improved error handling (we still need to validate further).

Action items:
- Jordan: try the three immediate mitigations and report back failure rate (today).
- Marissa: I'll prepare a short guidance doc/snippet for your customer (examples for chunking + batch-size defaults).
- Dev: I'll open SUP-3421 to track the server-side circuit breaker/backpressure work and prioritize a patch.

Let me know if you want me to schedule a short pairing session with your SREs to test.

— Camila

Team — quick update: we tested the three mitigations this morning in staging:

- Reduced reranker candidates to top-20: failure rate dropped from ~8% to ~0.5%
- Reduced embedding batch size to 4: no 5xxs observed in 2h smoke test
- Set client timeout to 90s: no difference in success rate but helped avoid client-side timeouts during spikes

We will run a longer overnight job tonight with the new settings and report back by tomorrow morning. If overnight passes cleanly, we'll plan to roll to prod this weekend.

Thanks for the fast turnaround — Marissa, appreciate coordinating.
